name: Forge AI
description: An AI tab in the dev tools' menu (F3 / D-pad right): add AI characters (the actor variants the map has, such as the grunts and hunters that the launcher brings in from campaign maps) at the crosshair, put waypoints at the crosshair and have them patrol along them with the game's own AI and pathfinding. Works with a keyboard and a controller. Local games only.
